title: Before: Command durations require hover
description: The Checkout, Prompt, and Wait durations are hidden until pointer hover.

title: Before: Agent time shown at completion
description: After completion in the open live view, the header shows agent time: 5m 30s. Reopening changes the metric, as the next capture shows.

title: Before: Reopening changes the duration metric
description: The reopened view shows run time: 28m 20s. The same recorded run showed agent time, 5m 30s, before reopening.

title: After: Command durations remain visible
description: Checkout 1s, Prompt 29s, and Wait 5m remain visible without pointer hover.

title: After: Run time explanation with keyboard focus
description: The tooltip explains setup and waits, separate counting of concurrent runs, and exclusion of currently queued runs. Keyboard focus opens it.

title: After: Run duration shown at completion
description: After completion in the open live view, the header shows Run time 28m 20s. This includes the simulated 22m 50s before the agent starts.

title: After: Run duration stays unchanged after reopening
description: The reopened view keeps Run time 28m 20s, matching the value shown before reopening.

title: After: Command durations in the dark theme
description: Checkout 1s, Prompt 29s, and Wait 5m remain visible in the dark theme.

title: After: Command durations at 390 CSS pixels
description: At 390 CSS pixels, all three command durations remain visible. The header wraps, and the page has no horizontal overflow.
